verdict.rationale: x402 is documented as a versioned protocol under open Linux Foundation governance (v2 support tables, TSC oversight, npm package with SLSA provenance) and has clear spec docs (how-it-works, facilitator support tables), but there is no published formal schema (e.g., JSON Schema/OpenAPI) or explicit conformance/validation test suite in evidence — the openapi probe returned 404s and no conformance-testing tool is mentioned. missing for 10: published machine-readable schema (OpenAPI/JSON Schema), an official conformance or validation test suite/tool, and independent confirmation of protocol versioning practices beyond npm version numbers.
